# llms.txt

> playflow: YAML-driven Playwright automation engine for repetitive browser tasks on dated intranet platforms. Write workflow YAML (steps, conditions, loops, variables), run via CLI or Python.

- Docs: https://timmycheng.cn/playflow/
- AI usage guide (how agents should drive playflow): https://timmycheng.cn/playflow/ai/
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/playflow/
- Install: pip install playflow
- Validate before running: playflow validate wf.yaml && playflow run wf.yaml --dry-run
